notes: Extracted from the guide and docs/evidence/cardbankaccount.md at e7ed622. The evidence and the guide's Sources note were checked on 19 October 2026 on v0.1.78-a116616; the evidence's 28 October note says Biscuit's ace46ca and dbe0e02 changed CardBankAccount for #344 and this guide's copy wasn't re-checked, waiting for #344's own publish. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Where the installed package contradicts the 19 October guide and evidence, the package wins and those sentences are not used: buttonDisabled disables the footer button (the guide's States say the card can't); without buttonLabel the card shows no button, and institutionName and items have no placeholder copy (the Sources note says placeholder copy); a long value is now cut before its label is squeezed (the row layout in CardBankAccount/accountRowLayout.ts), so the guide's 'a value never shrinks' sentences are not recorded and the short-values pair takes its Do caption as the reason; without institutionAvatar the card shows a monogram of the bank's initials (the copy snapshot itself renders 'JP'), not a stock photo, so the logo pair also takes its Do caption; the row values are set with Context ListItem and resolve to 12 px, so the anatomy's '14 px' for the value is left out; and disableTruncation reaches the header name, the badge, the values and the button, not only the values. The two gaps were measured on a116616; on dbe0e02 the word badge still resolves to light purple and the label line to 17 px. The guide names no other component to use instead, so avoidWhen is empty (Biscuit's unpublished mdx, summarised in the evidence, points to other components; the guide doesn't). Examples use the guide's own content (Jio Payments Bank with its logo, the green Active status Badge, the masked number, View statement, and the card's spoken name from the guide's code), set no modes on the card, and keep the status Badge's Semantic Intent System and AppearanceSystem positive, which the configuration gives a status badge; the in-context example drops the guide's Color Mode Light and its VStack's Slot gap M. Not recorded: the role-less root and default spoken name (not Coin gaps here), the published Storybook's older page and gold Default story, and the value-size, placeholder, stock-photo, long-value and testID discrepancies that dbe0e02 changed.

configuration.text: To show the footer button, set buttonLabel: the default button is hidden when it is omitted or empty.
With the default header, set institutionName: omitted or empty, the header has no bank name, as there is no placeholder (headerSlot replaces the header instead).
items gives one row per entry, a label and a value; omit it, or pass an empty list, for no rows. There is no placeholder copy.
buttonDisabled disables the default footer button; it is ignored when footer is provided.
disableTruncation lets the header name, the badge, the row values and the default footer button wrap instead of ending in an ellipsis.
The card's own defaults are Button / Size S, AppearanceBrand Secondary and Emphasis Medium; modes you pass are merged on top, and the same modes reach the badge, the button and the slots.
Button / Size S, the card's default, makes a 32 px button; M makes it 42 px and XS 24 px.

from.quote: Button / Size S, the default, is 32 px tall; M is 42 and XS 24.

examples.purpose: A linked savings account with four facts, the number masked, a green Active status Badge, and View statement as its one action; named for screen readers by the account.

<CardBankAccount
  institutionName="Jio Payments Bank"
  institutionAvatar={require('../assets/jio-gold-logo.png')}
  badge={<Badge label="Active" modes={{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'positive' }} />}
  items={[
    { label: 'Account type', value: 'Savings' },
    { label: 'Account number', value: '•••• 4521' },
    { label: 'IFSC', value: 'JIOP0000001' },
    { label: 'Last updated', value: 'Today, 9:14 AM' },
  ]}
  buttonLabel="View statement"
  onButtonPress={() => {}}
  accessibilityLabel="Jio Payments Bank savings account ending 4521"
/>

evidenceFacts.name: badge
evidenceFacts.description: A word becomes a Badge with the card's modes; a Badge you pass is given the card's modes with its own on top, so a status Badge keeps its green while the button stays purple.
evidenceFacts.quote: a Badge node with its own `{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System', AppearanceSystem: 'positive' }` keeps them (`#D4F6D0`/`#00773D`) while the button stays purple.

evidenceFacts.name: modes
evidenceFacts.description: The card's defaults (Button / Size S, AppearanceBrand Secondary, Emphasis Medium) sit under the modes you pass, and the same modes go to the badge, the button and the slots; the card itself doesn't read the theme provider.
evidenceFacts.quote: with the caller's `modes` merged on top; the same object goes to the badge, button and slots. The card doesn't read the theme provider.

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceBrand
evidenceFacts.description: With Emphasis, colours the footer button and a word badge. At Medium: Secondary (the card's default) light purple, Primary light gold, Neutral a dark grey button and a light grey badge, Tertiary a blue button and a light blue badge.
evidenceFacts.quote: AppearanceBrand × Emphasis colour the Button and a word Badge

evidenceFacts.name: Emphasis
evidenceFacts.description: With AppearanceBrand, colours the footer button and a word badge: High a solid button with a white label, Medium (the card's default) light, Low a transparent button and a pale badge.
evidenceFacts.quote: High Secondary `#5D00B5`/white; Low transparent button, badge `#F6F3FF`
